relationships.subject: dCA1Glu-ACCGlu pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these cumulative results demonstrated that excitation of the dCA1Glu → ACCGlu pathway plays a causal role in the development of withdrawal-induced hyperalgesia in mice before ethanol dependence.

relationships.subject: dCA1 glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These data thus demonstrated that dCA1Glu neurons send functional, monosynaptic, excitatory glutamatergic projections to ACCGlu neurons.

key_findings: Withdrawal from short-term ethanol before dependence causes mechanical hyperalgesia with elevated dCA1Glu and ACCGlu activity.
Chemogenetic inhibition of dCA1Glu-ACCGlu alleviates hyperalgesia; activation induces it in naive mice.
